findings.description: The VAL_FIX 8 baseline paragraph for ledger 79 does not reconcile with the sentence two lines above it. It states the pre-merge run counted 189 passed + 1 skipped and derives this as 67 (this change) + 123 (pre-existing) = 190 collected. The same E2E section says the pre-merge VALIDATE run of 2026-10-10 'had skipped' the 15 rsync-gated tests. Both cannot hold for one run: 15 rsync skips plus the node_modules skip would give 16 skipped, so either the pre-merge total was 174 passed + 16 skipped (and 123 is wrong), or the 15 rsync tests were not skipped in the run whose count is 189 + 1, or the two sentences describe different pre-merge runs. Ledger 79 asked precisely for the 189 -> 255 delta to be explained; the explanation as written is internally contradictory. Fix: name which pre-merge run each number comes from, and give the pass/skip split that includes the rsync skips.
